scenes.script_text: Every single day, more than 8,000 people die in the United States.
It's a statistic almost everyone hears... and almost everyone forgets.
But have you ever stopped to ask a different question?
It sounds like the beginning of a crime documentary, but it's actually the foundation of a multi-billion-dollar industry.
And here's the part that surprises most people: some cemetery owners can continue generating revenue for decades—even after every available burial plot has already been sold.
Welcome to one of America's most overlooked businesses.
Today, we're pulling back the curtain on an industry that quietly combines real estate, finance, long-term investing, and recurring revenue into one of the oldest business models ever created.
So... You Want To Own A Cemetery?
